scope: Manually established synthetic labels, independent of evaluator outputs

complete.reason: 100 unreserved patties for 100 burgers; continuous evidenced line booking and delivery fit deadline

shortage.reason: 70 patties, no incoming supply, no competitors or reservations, demand 100: shortage 30

empty_stock.reason: 0 patties and no incoming supply for demand 100: shortage 100

missing_production.reason: No rates, plan or complete job ledger

missing_current_version.reason: Historical calculation may be feasible, but current authority must not accept missing version

complete.reason: 80 patties minus 20 owned reservation leaves 60; 40 receipt delayed past first use; second has protected stock and later booking buffer

two_affected.reason: New complete two-order fixture: baseline sequential jobs at 09:00 and 10:40 fit; delayed 110 receipt at 11:00 removes 70 and 40 required units, also after receiving cutoff. Both start FEASIBLE; original material-only fixture is unchanged

material_only.reason: Production proof unavailable; material delta alone cannot prove full feasibility

confounded.reason: Concurrent stock change outside supplier event scope prevents safe causal attribution

preexisting.reason: Same shortage before and after; receipt already after both material-use times, so no new adverse delta
